newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma lowered to reduce.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Gruma lowered to reduce.

text.p: -- Robert Flemings Research said it downgraded Mexican tortilla-maker Gruma S.A. to reduce from long-term buy.
-- Analyst Kevin Kirkeby said Gruma has risen 147 percent in absolute terms and outperformed the market by 117 percent.
-- "We feel the shares are extended -- the price bouyed by sentiment and not by underlying fundamentals," the report said.
-- The analyst cited cash flow estimates and the price U.S. agro giant Archer Daniels Midland paid for its 22 percent stake in Gruma as the basis for his skepticism regarding current valuations.
-- "The revenue contribution from the association with ADM will be slower to arrive than the market is expecting," the report said.
